scope: Unchanged authored model-free synthetic retrieval fixtures. Not independent real-user accuracy, rendered shell execution or production latency.
trial_disposition: Initial outcomes were measured before strengthening the cap proof to reject leading-zero/octal literals. The accepted binary includes that guard. An old diagnostic test was updated to assert five raw candidates, four relevance exclusions and one remaining candidate, while retaining the four-note delivery cap and relevant-note assertion.
limits: Shell value suppression recognizes a unique literal decimal clamp, not arbitrary arithmetic or runtime behavior. Dynamic dispatch and computed source paths keep broad ranked-note retrieval.
Late linked rationale focus retains earlier ranked evidence. It does not invent relevance from unavailable or unretrieved notes.
Same-symbol topic discrimination is a lexical heuristic for separately quantified policies; unquantified additional explanations and uncertain grounding remain eligible.
Bare numbers are not assigned units and unmatched paraphrases are not given guessed meanings. Same-symbol nonnumeric distractors and ambiguous requests still over-return in Python.
Default counted mode is unchanged; all 100 percent recall claims in this comparison refer to symbol links enabled.
